environment.description: Same Step Functions EXPRESS workflow deployed behind API Gateway with identical Lambda code. The frontend application that submits tokens loads its encryption library via script tags with Subresource Integrity (SRI) hashes (sha384). The API Gateway has a resource policy restricting invocations to requests originating from the VPC endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f) associated with the internal application subnet. Additionally, the Step Functions state machine has a ResultSelector configured on the ValidateSessionToken state that maps ONLY '$.body.validated' and '$.body.user_id' fields to the next state output, with a fallback Catch block that returns a generic '{"error": "validation_failed"}' for any States.TaskFailed. The API Gateway response mapping template overwrites the integration response with a fixed template: '#set($root = $input.path("$")) {"status": "$root.status"}' discarding detailed error bodies. CloudFront distribution in front with Origin Request Policy that strips all headers except Content-Type and Authorization.

config.sri_enforcement: sha384 integrity attributes on all client-side crypto scripts
config.network: VPC endpoint only, no public internet access to API
